name: linkedin-api
description: LinkedIn member and organization posts, images, comments and reactions via the official LinkedIn REST API

nodes.title: Get LinkedIn member
nodes.description: Read the signed-in member (OpenID userinfo: sub, name, email, picture) and their person_urn.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Create LinkedIn post
nodes.description: Publish a text post as a member or organization, optionally with an uploaded image or an article link. Returns the post URN.

little_text_format.description: true sends `text` as raw LinkedIn Little Text Format (mentions, {hashtag|\#|tag}); false escapes reserved characters

article_url.description: https link to share as an article

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get LinkedIn post
nodes.description: Read one post by URN (as its author).

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
